comparisons.instruction_vs_pipeline: envelope24 only; reuse the original no-rule pipeline baseline; mutual L0 passes only. Positive left-minus-right is the extra lift cost of the instruction condition.
comparisons.interval: Paired map bootstrap, 10000 resamples, Python random.Random(0), percentile 95% nearest ranks (ceil(p*n)-1). Resample whole pairs. Mean difference always defined when a pair exists; saving fraction omits zero-baseline bootstrap resamples and reports their retained count; zero observed baseline yields null saving fraction.
comparisons.missing: Missing lift measures yield unavailable comparisons and explicit missing map IDs, never invented zero values. Failures cannot enter the mutual-pass population. Primary quoting follows the registered interval gate; all other intervals secondary.
comparisons.paired_summary: For each measure, report map IDs/n, mean left and right, mean left-minus-right, wins/ties/losses (lower lifts wins), saving fraction 1-mean(left)/mean(right), and paired intervals. No unpaired comparison or cross-cohort pooling.
comparisons.pass_table: 2x2 both_pass,pipeline_only,twostep_only,neither, separate from mutual lift savings; sensitivity table for twostep_300 envelope only.
comparisons.pipeline_vs_twostep: Separately within tiny15, small30 and envelope24; mutual L0 passes only, with all-map pass counts alongside.

exclusions: None based on outcomes, feasibility, target presence, timing, envelope rejection or lift value. Every registered map and attempted arm remains in the table. Errors and interrupted trials remain explicit; no replacement or silent retry. Incomplete or harness-error reports are provisional.

execution.admission: Wait for fresh core-state.json: integer mask, enabled popcount>=workers+2, finite0<=load1<=workers+2, age[0,120)s and explicit other_fleet_work:[]; missing exclusivity metadata waits. No other fleet work. workers<=enabled cores-2.
execution.authorized_runner_assembly: sealed.runner_seam supplies only worker single-use plan-phase authorized/hash-verified loaded instance; exact packet pin, process-local provenance each assembly read, empty standing/standard/no replacements; ordinary runner private fence remains and loader restoredfinally.
execution.compute_reduction: Drop nonpipeline arms except registered simple baseline/sensitivity; reuse baseline instruction comparator. Preserve standard profile and gates.
execution.fleet_exclusivity_attestation: leader_run_sealed: executing run_sealed.sh explicitly attests no other fleet work and GPU free; launcher bridge may append other_fleet_work:[] only with that attestation plus lattice STOP and progress.active==0, preserving fresh actual core-state mask/load/timestamp/provenance; otherwise admission waits.
execution.freeze: Use p21 require_frozen(manifest, full_weights=True), pipeline layer only, before claims/openings; exact registered standard recipe and p21 import-closure/evidence inventory; no legacy900s/source census or blanket runs-path exclusion for public freeze evidence.
execution.map_audit: Log every opened map path and measured byte SHA256 within the one run, including rule prepass reads; bind to the registered cohort metadata. No sealed timing pilot.
execution.one_run: Global exclusive sealed claim and process-exclusive driver lock before any sealed map opens. A consumed run cannot be run again; no alternative output directory bypass. No retry of an attempted timed trial. Every prepass, planning and audit request has a driver-issued single-use capability bound to run, map hash, arm, phase, job and request payload. Planning consumes it atomically before map/search work; direct worker retries, phase substitution, dead-controller and failed/interrupted-run requests are rejected.
execution.result_audit: Fresh subprocess independently recomputes full checker, completion replay, every instruction and counterfactual recheck, level and all lift measures against the committed raw result. Require audit_verified and audit_fresh_process before a result can count as a pass; raw plans and unverified results cannot support claims. Audit/worker exceptions and timeouts remain explicit unverified error rows; every registered identity is consolidated, including completed siblings and not-run reasons. Raw evidence is preserved and no spent trial is retried. Child timeout/crash/auditfailure retains status:error,harness_error and partial evidence; remaining trials continue, no retries. Finally publishes provisional report. Source-integrity failure stops future openings. D275 supersedes planning-timeout classification: clean planning deadline becomes deadline_exceeded, no plan within the time budget; retain a before-deadline checked incumbent only after fresh independent audit. Crash, cleanup failure and audit failure remain error.
execution.runtime_projection: D276 accepts44 completed timing rows across all8cohort/arm cells, separate from17 supplemental calibration baselines and4lost in-flight rows. Exact-profile loaded-machine projection with audits, full-weight guard/setup costs, one max-job scheduling tail and1800s live-reader reserve; four workers/18quiet enabled cores. Admission additional/unbounded; no clean-machine timing claim.
execution.worker_default: Four workers for sealed release on18enabled cores; two is a legacy development default only.

instruction_selection.claim: Primary binding obedient passes / maps whose fresh-audited no-rule plan broke the rule, overall/per type. Instructed plan requires fresh-audited L0. Already obeyed and unavailable counterfactuals separate; load boxes in different physical cells; signed instruction lift change, already-obeyed pairs as search-noise floor.
instruction_selection.dev_revision: Physical-minus-three selected from five live-v2 L0 dev baselines: minus2 binds0/5, minus3 binds3/5. Globalminus3 rejected for capacity shortfalls. Profile epochs retained apart. Full32fresh-audited majority gate unchanged.
instruction_selection.development_release_check: 20 fresh-audited committed development L0 baseline plans break fixed cap;5no-plan and7unknown retained,20/32 exceeds strict17/32. Audit implementation corrected to registered full-checker/physical-completion definition without new search/retry.
instruction_selection.ordering: Sort the 24 maps by canonical JSON of public_facts(instance), with map_id as final tie-breaker. Rank starts at zero. If a map cannot be loaded/projected, retain its unavailable condition and sort it after valid facts by map_id. This fallback consults no planning result.
instruction_selection.parameters: Sorted physical odd context bay at (rank//4)%bay_count. max_tiers uses deck if positive else hold, cap=max(0,physical-3); development majority-binding calibration required before release. DG most numerous matching class on load list, one vote per box/class including subsidiary/additional risks, lexical tie break; fallback3 with explicit no_matching_cargo; min_bays1. No redraw.
instruction_selection.population: All 24 envelope maps including any gate rejection; never screen for an easy, feasible, or nonvacuous rule.
instruction_selection.public_facts: Deterministic public_facts(instance): vessel keys id,cells,stacks,bay_pairs,hatch_covers,exclusion_regions, plus all cargo projected onto length_ft,gross_mass_kg,pod,dg and sorted canonically. No yard, plan, checker, feasibility or lift result.
instruction_selection.rank_limit: Cargo sorts before ship, includes ashore background; rule type not stratified by ship.
instruction_selection.reader: Exactly once per instruction, serially during claimed prepass; instantiate reader once; record sentence/context/map/rule/allocation hashes, reading, evidence and wall time. Workers replay recorded readings only, never construct a reader. standing empty. Confirmation source sealed_expected_match; intended-rule equality, not a human confirmation.
instruction_selection.type_rule: types_in_order[rank % 4], hence exactly six maps per type; parameters selected deterministically from the same map's public facts by worker.select_rule (imported from instructions.py).
instruction_selection.vacuity: Retain and explicitly record missing target cargo or unsupported/empty physical geometry. No replacement map, rule type or parameter after seeing feasibility or outcomes. Persist each fixed rank/type with expected_rule:null and the error reason if drawing fails; never redraw. A fatal prepass writes FAILED and a provisional population-complete report.
instruction_selection.when: Only inside the one authorized run, after its exclusive claim and freeze verification, before any planner or outcome inspection.

metrics.D15: Later-port lifts are projected; current-port and projected later-port components are reported apart. Weighted objective and unweighted physical nonproductive lifts are named separately.
metrics.binding_obedient_passes: Primary binding obedient passes / maps whose fresh-audited no-rule plan broke the rule, overall/per type. Instructed plan requires fresh-audited L0. Already obeyed and unavailable counterfactuals separate; load boxes in different physical cells; signed instruction lift change, already-obeyed pairs as search-noise floor.
metrics.completion: Physical apply_plan replay legal and every load-list box loaded; full checker,L0,intended-rule recheck and fresh independent audit still required. Vectorized feasibility mask E9 is diagnostic only (OOG40ft overlength0.3m differs from shared scalar special case); preserve mask diagnostics without making them an extra hard rule.
metrics.instruction_cost: Signed instructed-minus-baseline unweighted extra lifts on mutual L0 passes; already-obeyed pairs separately as search-noise floor. Negative change is search variation, not rule benefit.
metrics.instruction_recheck: Pass, fail and unavailable counts for independent intended-rule recheck, plus all-map checked obedient passes. Apply the identical intended rule counterfactually to the no-rule baseline and report that recheck separately; a baseline counterfactual violation never changes the no-rule pass. No returned plan or refusal is not a successful recheck.
metrics.means: Only over passing maps; always publish n. Medium means are not comparable across envelope cells or different passing subsets.
metrics.out_of_envelope: Own column and status; retain in registered all-map denominator; never a pass and never silently excluded.
metrics.passes: All-map count and fraction of L0 full-checker-passing, complete plans obeying every confirmed instruction; never count L1-L5 as passes. Exact two-sided Clopper-Pearson95 intervals beside every pass count. Ship split500-800 vs1700 for tiny/small, envelope by ship; no finer rates.
metrics.per_map_csv: One row per attempted map/arm including identity, opened byte hash, status, level, pass and instruction flags, current/projected/total/weighted lifts, wall seconds and surrogate label.
metrics.plan_difference: Count load-list boxes with different final physical cell sets between same-map baseline and instructed plans; null if either plan unavailable.
metrics.relaxed: Counts by returned ladder level apart from passes, retaining broken rules and boxes ashore in worker evidence.
metrics.time: Wall seconds per map/arm, mean, minimum, maximum and sum; driver total elapsed/admission information retained as metadata. No projection is a measured clean-machine runtime.
